_comment: Code patches translated into ffxivgame.exe (recomp.py --apply), as Garlemald Client applies them to the file (client/src/launcher/pe_patch.rs). Addresses are VAs (image base 0x400000).

server_utc_pin._why: call <host UTC> -> mov eax, 0x50E0E812 (2012-12-31): the game rejects a host time far past SERVER_UTC

assert_log._why: the fatal-assert handler sends its text to OutputDebugStringA and returns, instead of a no-op callback and a write to address 0

null_this_guard._why: a byte getter some callers reach with this == NULL: returns 0 for them

null_member8_write._why: the store through the same NULL member after the getter: dropped
